latest_release.body:
Changes since 1.2.20

* release(langgraph): 1.2.21 (#9683)
* chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 9 updates (#9530)
* fix(langgraph): match whole namespace segments in get_subgraphs (#9615)
* fix(langgraph): read an undeclared subgraph namespace with the parent graph (#9614)
* docs(langgraph): say each interrupt() call has its own id in UnknownInterruptError (#9600)
* chore(deps): bump filelock and langgraph-api for security fixes (#9606)
